raw_text:
Read all files referenced by the invoking prompt's execution_context before starting. Parse phase number (integer or decimal); if missing, show: `ERROR: Phase number required`; `Usage: /gsd:remove-phase <phase-number>`; `Example: /gsd:remove-phase 17`.

Run `INIT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" init phase-op "${target}")`; if `"$INIT" == <REDACTED_USER>:*`, run `INIT=$(cat "${INIT#<REDACTED_USER>:}")`. Extract `phase_found`, `phase_dir`, `phase_number`, `commit_docs`, `roadmap_exists`; read STATE.md and ROADMAP.md.

Target must be > current phase in STATE.md. Otherwise show specified error and use `/gsd:pause-work`. Present removal summary; wait for confirmation.

**Delegate the entire removal operation to gsd-tools:**
`RESULT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" phase remove "${target}")`
If executed plans (SUMMARY.md files) cause error, use `--force` only if the user confirms:
`RESULT=$(node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" phase remove "${target}" --force)`

Commit:
`node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" commit "chore: remove phase {target} ({original-phase-name})" --files .planning/`

Don't remove completed phases (have SUMMARY.md files) without --force
Don't remove current or past phases
Don't manually renumber — use `gsd-tools phase remove` which handles all renumbering
Don't add "removed phase" notes to STATE.md — git commit is the record
Don't modify completed phase directories
